data.title: Firefox, a protein encoded by circular RNA circPVT1, is essential for MYC-driven oncogenesis
data.authors: Tiwari A, Paithane U, Tashiro K, Hall B, Friedlein J, Saraswat M, Saulnier O, Barbosa K, Trinh Q, Bagchi A, et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.model_system: Human MYC-amplified cancer cell lines; xenograft mouse models
data.finding: A micropeptide (Firefox/FFX) encoded by the circular RNA circPVT1 stimulates AKT-mTORC1 signaling and cap-dependent translation to sustain MYC protein abundance and transcriptional output. FFX depletion reduces MYC levels and impairs tumor growth in MYC-amplified xenograft models, identifying an mTORC1-linked vulnerability in MYC-driven cancers.

extracted_findings.target: AKT-mTORC1 signalling and cap-dependent translation, sustaining MYC
extracted_findings.species: Human MYC-amplified cancer cell lines; mouse xenografts
extracted_findings.effect: The micropeptide sustains AKT-mTORC1 signalling and cap-dependent translation; depleting it lowered MYC protein and impaired xenograft tumour growth.
